options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com:8443/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: clear_mel_events
options.description: This flag will force firmware to be activated in spite of the storage system mel-event issues. Warning! This will clear all storage system mel-events. Use at your own risk!

options.name: firmware
options.description: Path to the firmware file. Due to concurrency issues, use M(netapp_eseries.santricity.na_santricity_proxy_firmware_upload) to upload firmware and nvsram to SANtricity Web Services Proxy when upgrading multiple systems at the same time on the same instance of the proxy.

options.name: nvsram
options.description: Path to the NVSRAM file. NetApp recommends upgrading the NVSRAM when upgrading firmware. Due to concurrency issues, use M(netapp_eseries.santricity.na_santricity_proxy_firmware_upload) to upload firmware and nvsram to SANtricity Web Services Proxy when upgrading multiple systems at the same time on the same instance of the proxy.

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.

options.name: wait_for_completion
options.description: This flag will cause module to wait for any upgrade actions to complete. When changes are required to both firmware and nvsram and task is executed against SANtricity Web Services Proxy, the firmware will have to complete before nvsram can be installed.
